name: Silvery Spinnerets
summary: Silvery Spinnerets are harvested from the great spider Lady Sathrah in northern Teldrassil. Once used to weave webs that captured blessed morning dew for the Temple of the Moon, they are sought by the Priestesses of Elune to honor the fallen creature's soul through a sacred ritual of rebirth.

sections.title: Sacred Webbing and Corruption
sections.body: Lady Sathrah was once counted among the favored creatures of Elune, renowned for spinning shimmering webs through the moonlight near Wellspring Lake. Her silver silk gathered the evening mist, forming healing dews prized by the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus. Unfortunately, the corruption creeping through the boughs of Teldrassil did not spare her. Falling into violent madness, Sathrah became a danger to her own brood and the surrounding forest. Priestess A'moora asks travelers to end the spider's suffering and recover her spinnerets as an act of mercy, bringing closure to a revered resident of the great boughs.

sections.title: A Sacrifice for Rebirth
sections.body: The recovered spinnerets are not sought as a mere trophy or crafting material. Instead, the Sisterhood offers them directly to the Moon Goddess atop the Temple of the Moon. Through this consecration, known as Sathrah's Sacrifice, the priestesses pray that Elune will receive the creature's spirit, cleanse the madness that claimed her mortal body, and grant her peace in rebirth.

faq.q: Where do you get the Silvery Spinnerets?
faq.answer: They are retrieved from Lady Sathrah, a large spider found along the northern borders of Teldrassil near Wellspring Lake.

faq.q: Why does Priestess A'moora want the spinnerets?
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora seeks to offer them to Elune as a sacred sacrifice. This ritual honors Lady Sathrah's former purity and petitions the goddess to cleanse the beast's spirit and grant her peace and rebirth.

faq.q: Why were Lady Sathrah's webs special?
faq.answer: Lady Sathrah spun luminous silver silk that caught the evening mist beneath the moonlight. The dew gathered from her webs possessed potent restorative magic, which the Sisterhood of Elune stored in the Temple of the Moon for healing.

faq.q: Why was Lady Sathrah killed if she was sacred?
faq.answer: She descended into incurable madness alongside other corrupted wildlife in Teldrassil. Her aggression endangered the forest and threatened her future broods, leading the priestesses to deem slaying her a sorrowful act of mercy.

angles.text: The tragic end of Lady Sathrah is a sobering reminder to the Kaldorei that even creatures beloved by Elune are vulnerable to the creeping affliction sickening Teldrassil.
For servants of Elune, retrieving the spinnerets is not an extermination contract, but a sacred funeral rite designed to petition the Mother Moon for a creature's redemption.
